player.title: player
player.description: The player to receive the effect. A player name `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the player.

effect.title: effect
effect.description: An `enum` to specify the effect being added or removed.

seconds.title: seconds
seconds.description: An `integer` that specifies the duration, in seconds, of this effect. Default: `30`.

amplifier.title: amplifier
amplifier.description: An `integer` that may have been applied to this effect. Sample values range typically from 0 to 4. Default: `0`.

hideparticles.title: hideParticles
hideparticles.description: A `Boolean` that specifies the visual representation of the effect. Default: `false`.
